name: Empire State Fall 2022
information:
Day 1 Events: 3x3 Cube, 4x4 Cube, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Skewb
Day 2 Events: 5x5 Cube, 6x6 Cube, 7x7 Cube, Clock, Square-1, 4x4 Blindfolded

**Competitors may bring at most one guest.**

# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof that they satisfy one of the following two requirements in order to be allowed in the venue:

##### -They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, October 22nd is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
**OR**
##### -They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, November 1st is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
